prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1427; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports their vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered the intersection against the signal. Claimant states they were transported from the scene by ambulance with complaints of pain in the right knee. Police report requested and pending.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says they prefer to handle the claim directly. Claimant describes persistent right knee pain, swelling, and difficulty bearing weight since the collision. Explained the claims process, the documents needed, and the option to seek independent legal advice if they wish. Claimant has been provided a written statement form to complete.

Entry 3: Received the at-fault party's statement through their carrier. The other driver admits to not stopping for the red signal but disputes the speed of approach. Intersection camera footage has been requested from the municipality. Liability appears probable against the other driver, pending review of the footage and police findings.

Entry 4: Claimant submitted a medical release and treatment summary from the treating clinic. Diagnosis noted as a right knee sprain with possible meniscal involvement; MRI has been ordered by the treating physician. Claimant reports missing several days of work and is awaiting employer documentation of time lost. Reviewed the file for any prior right knee complaints; none found in the records provided so far.

Entry 5: Followed up with claimant regarding the outstanding wage loss form and MRI results. Claimant is continuing physiotherapy twice weekly and reports slow improvement. Advised claimant that the file will remain open pending the imaging report and final medical update. Scheduled a reminder to review liability and the intersection footage once received.
